Morgan —

Appreciate the diagrams. Quick read-through below and a few clarifying questions before our architecture review on Tuesday: 

1) Control plane placement: from the PDF it looks like the control plane sits in a VPC peered back to your management segment. We can run the control plane in your VPC or in Redwood-managed private control plane inside your VPC. Need to confirm which you prefer for certificate trust (we recommend Redwood-managed for faster cert rotation).

2) KV/Cache subnet: we prefer an isolated /27 for the KV cache and gRPC telemetry (reduces burst contention). Is that possible given your IP plan?

3) Egress NAT mapping: your CSV shows overlapping SNAT ranges with the analytics cluster. We'll propose a reserved SNAT pool for inference egress — see suggested ranges in redwood-runbook-draft.md (attached).

Proposed next steps: architecture review on Tue 2026-11-17 14:00 PT (60m). If that works, we'll invite the infra team to walk the fiber schedule and blackout windows.

Action items: please confirm (a) preferred control plane hosting model, (b) whether you can open a /27 for KV, and (c) maintenance blackout windows for 11/20.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
